decisions.why: Panamatic bedpan washer disinfectors are ward/sluice-room decontamination equipment for reusable patient-care items, matching central decontamination

Pulpmatic and Incomatic macerators dispose of disposable pulp bedpans and incontinence products via sluice-room decontamination processing, the same central decontamination category as this supplier's bedpan washers
